requirements_summary: Enterprise robotics customer needing deterministic inference tails for teleoperation. Targets: p50 8-12ms, p95 <25ms, p99 <45ms for short prompts (<256 tokens). Peak sustained throughput 400-500 qps with 15-min bursts to 800 qps. Requires reserved GPU pools across two NA regions with automatic failover and >=20% spare headroom. Model pinning, KV-prefix caching, quantization guidance. Private control plane (VPC) and HSM/KMS required. SLA target 99.95% uptime for Dedicated pool with defined maintenance windows and credits.
notes: Customer is robotics fleet operator: latency impacts operator control and safety; not tolerant of long tails

POC acceptance criteria: p99 latency within 1.5x baseline and <=5% request errors under 2x declared peak for 30 minutes
